body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; when one is fixed and live, revise this entry. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check (results.json expected = before = after) does. Rev 71 (2026-10-19 13:13Z): the own-cache --target-dir line is corrected (w-32d02e1dd7f6), and naming 409s are added (w-33f4cde5413c).

!! REVIEW INTEGRITY (P1 w-9d4b9b00c603): a COMPACT delegation result can say "Findings: None" while the FULL output lists findings. Judge every review, explorer or evaluator result ONLY from the FULL output. Review results are parent-only (w-fb35d7e76d72): termal_get_session_result returns 404 to any session but the delegation's parent, so the parent copies the complete findings and notes verbatim to a file under MAIN target/tmp and sends the path. Record explorer results on the item promptly.

!! CLAUDE SESSIONS: never start a background Bash task, a Monitor or a subagent; TermAl restricts the session's test credit until it ends. Keep store checks short (never `engram doctor` on a live store from the foreground tool).

CHECKS AND CREDIT
- Run checks through `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- ...` (or full). Results persist in .git/worktrees/<wt>/review-runs/<test>/results.json. A BARE command that outlives its turn loses its result (w-8f7e2d914724). A detached run SURVIVES a TermAl restart (test-da9f3ced kept running across the 05:17Z restart on 10-19).
- CLAUDE lanes: ONE call `pushd "DIR" && <test>` is credited; piping, redirecting or chaining around it is not (w-1d9259ed138e). CODEX lanes run launcher commands through native exec. A compound line with an env prefix is refused credit by design (w-7b952e51f788): use a SINGLE launcher line.
- TARGET DIR (w-32d02e1dd7f6): a --target-dir OUTSIDE the named root (e.g. a sibling worktree's cache) is REFUSED credit. Credited checks use a target dir INSIDE the named root or the default ./target: accept a slower fresh build, or copy a cache into the root before naming it. Never rerun only for credit; a later full gate carries the evidence. A borrowed or parked target dir may expose stale binaries (w8376b03f2259).
- Credit binds to the turn's FOCUSED claim and the root's NAMED binding; a run from an unnamed or unbound root gets "item: undeclared" and no credit (w-fec83085cff0). Never rerun only for credit.
- Nothing wakes an idle session (w-1df557dae3ac): the coordinator wakes lanes after a "next turn" step.
- Overlapped checks are indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480). Codex: a focused run is recorded only if it ends while its starting turn is open (w-67d248c998ef).
- Under host load, a passing detached gate can be refused credit with "no run appeared within ten minutes" (P1 w-645c884b2cbc).
- A cancelled or idle delegation may keep holding a worktree folder: `git worktree remove` gets "Permission denied" (P2 w-eaee4f7c441c). Leave it; no force, no kill.
- ANY command run by a non-Claude session in a carried gate's root, even a read-only `git diff`, makes the host refuse that gate's credit (w-4a8d9a7a7d08, w-0fd88ccb42dd). Export patches BEFORE the launch or after the END.

NAMED SOURCE ROOTS
- Never root credited work at the MAIN checkout; use a clean detached worktree (.worktrees/NAME). termal_name_source_root {work, path}; it takes effect next turn. Clear: {work} with NO path, from a live claim. The 64-slot table is shared: own-clear after done. GET /api/engram/named-roots lists roots; POST /api/engram/named-roots/release is the audited release.
- NAMING 409s (w-33f4cde5413c, P2): "named-root acknowledgement belongs to a superseded authority image" on a near-idle host (10-19 12:40Z); one identical retry succeeded. An evaluator delegation can also end with 409 "root generation N no longer named under this claim": refresh the naming, then spawn ONE fresh evaluator. Release writer latency under gate load is the separate w-1fcaa9b93d12 (500 "authority persistence is unconfirmed (Deadline)"). A 409 "canonical run and binding remain open" is CORRECT for open items: they need the owner's clear or the audited completed-root path (w-4d6283a1f1f5). Slots free reliably only by an owner's own-clear after done. A naming 409 at 64/64 means wait for a freed slot; no retry loops.
- After a host restart, claims may lapse (recover them with a reason).

GATES: from the named root, FOREGROUND: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135 --item <ref>`. START to Fable2 before LAUNCH NOW; gate and pair in parallel; a failed gate discards that round's reviews. No edits in a gated root; no supported cancel. Check disk before gates. A gate GO needs every warm series' mailed END first.

EVALUATIONS (P1 w-539ea7e8b506): after termal_evaluate_acceptance, make no tracker write that turn. Reusing a settled evaluator or explorer may fail (409 "thread was archived manually", or a 500 unarchive timeout; w-049ac52c3f72); then spawn ONE fresh one. One holder note per criterion, at most 3.5 KB. A pre-push evaluation gates the deliverable criteria; a criterion about the landing itself is evaluated fresh after the install. Closure: land, fresh evaluation, done, own-clear LAST; FF main only after done.

APPROVALS AND QUEUES: Codex lanes are on host AUTO-APPROVE. A lane waiting for a human is PARKED: tell Fable2. queuePaused=true for under a minute between turns is normal; a wake may report durableButNotWoken or heldBehindPausedQueue meanwhile. A persistently stuck head (w-7635e5349aab): ask Fable2 to cancel it and resume. A resumed turn may replay the OLD plan (w-e4c65f30c77b). A model-capacity turn failure ("Selected model is at capacity") leaves the session status=error with queuePaused=true: ask Fable2 to resume the queue, and queue a superseding HOLD first if a START was pending.

MAILBOX: an idempotency key is unique per SENDER across ALL recipients (P3 w-b7b80d980e7a), so use a recipient-qualified key. Don't call list_mailboxes from the watchdog (huge); read known mailboxes. A HOLD sent while a lane's turn is active is queued behind it, so a run already started completes; disclose any overlap.

OTHER: Codex "blocked by policy" refusals (w-e2a5af1634f0): plain single commands, never bypass. Reviewer briefs start with "read and follow .claude/commands/review-code.md"; read-only reviewers cannot read tracker notes, so put agreed texts in a MAIN target/tmp file and cite it. The watchdog cron lives only in the session; after a restart check CronList (it survived the 10-19 restart and the 10-19 ~10Z Windows reboot). Spurious "Evidence restricted ... then lifted" notice pairs after watchdog ticks (P2 w-350df830dfd0): no action needed. After an OS crash: SQLite (Engram and TermAl) can lose the last minutes of commits (Engram w-088e358107e0; TermAl w-35bdcb766b6c).
